channel.title: EmbeddedOS Newsroom
channel.description: Open-source embedded AI systems stack — RTOS, embedded AI, neural interface, secure boot, tools, apps and platforms.

item.title: eos-platform 1.0 lands: one toolchain, every EoS profile
item.description: After eighteen months of incremental releases, the eos-platform meta-distribution reaches 1.0 with stable APIs, a unified package manifest, and reproducible builds across all 14 EoS components.
item.dc:creator: EoS Editorial

item.title: EAI 0.9 ships INT4 LLM runtime — 11 tok/s on a Cortex-M85
item.description: EAI's new quantized inference path squeezes a 1.3B-parameter model into 312 MB of flash and runs at interactive speed on a 480 MHz microcontroller.
item.dc:creator: EoS Editorial

item.title: ENI's 1,024-channel pipeline: deterministic spike sorting in 800 µs
item.description: How the Embedded Neural Interface stack moves a thousand-electrode array through filtering, sorting, and decoding inside a single RTOS frame.
item.dc:creator: EoS Editorial

item.title: eBootloader secure boot: a measured-launch walkthrough
item.description: An end-to-end tour of eBoot's chain of trust — root-of-trust keys, immutable stage 0, signed manifests, anti-rollback counters, and runtime attestation.
item.dc:creator: EoS Editorial

item.title: EoSim 2.4 HIL bridge: virtual peripherals talking to real silicon
item.description: EoSim 2.4 introduces a bidirectional hardware-in-the-loop bridge — drive simulated EoS images from a real PHY, or drive real boards from a simulated MMIO bus.
item.dc:creator: EoS Editorial

item.title: eDB ships AES-XTS at-rest encryption — even on 64 KB devices
item.description: eDB's new storage layer adds page-level AES-XTS encryption with hardware-key offload on supported MCUs — fitting in 6 KB of code on the smallest target.
item.dc:creator: EoS Editorial

item.title: Foundation 2026 membership: governance, voting, working groups
item.description: The 2026 membership cycle opens with three new working groups (Safety-Certified, Embedded AI Ethics, Neural Interface Standards) and a refreshed governance charter.
item.dc:creator: EoS Editorial

item.title: EoS RTOS roadmap 2026: tickless idle, RT-IPC, formal verification
item.description: Three large RTOS bets for 2026: a tickless scheduler with sub-microsecond wake latency, RT-IPC primitives sharing memory across security domains, and a formally verified context-switch path.
item.dc:creator: EoS Editorial
